verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents a quickstart that has you create a free UK merchant account and complete a first test payment (docs-32). Client credentials are retrieved in Console (docs-21), and official SDKs exist for Node.js, Python, Java and .NET that automate request signing (docs-11, docs-24, gh-1). The path does require setting up an ECDSA key pair on top of the bearer token (docs-12), which adds onboarding steps. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox bank-account linking quickstart (the documented quickstart is payment-focused), any evidence of time-to-first-call speed, independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding flow, and SDK coverage beyond four languages.
